title: National Geographic double-blind remote viewing of the Dumbarton Bridge

tellings.quote: the end of the dumb Barton Bridge

plain: In a test filmed for National Geographic, the former Army remote viewer Joe McMoneagle says he described a hidden target that turned out to be the end of the Dumbarton Bridge, which crosses San Francisco Bay. Remote viewing means trying to describe a distant place by the mind alone, and the test was double-blind, so neither he nor the person with him knew the target. McMoneagle tells it as something he took part in, with a man he calls Ed, as evidence that the skill works under strict conditions.
